name: Slice of life + arousal
description: Trust, respect and feelings that build slowly, a power balance, and an arousal meter that rises and falls quickly. Written for characters whose cards have no sexual content.

levels.name: Distrustful
levels.instruction: {{char}} doesn't believe what {{user}} says without proof and keeps anything personal back.

levels.name: Wary
levels.instruction: {{char}} gives {{user}} the benefit of the doubt on small things, but nothing that matters.

levels.name: Cautious
levels.instruction: {{char}} is starting to rely on {{user}} for small things and quietly checks whether it's deserved.

levels.name: Trusting
levels.instruction: {{char}} takes {{user}} at their word and shares things {{char}} wouldn't tell most people.

levels.name: Complete trust
levels.instruction: {{char}} trusts {{user}} completely, with secrets, fears and safety.

levels.name: Contempt
levels.instruction: {{char}} looks down on {{user}}: dismisses {{user}}'s opinions and doesn't take {{user}} seriously.

levels.name: Unimpressed
levels.instruction: {{char}} isn't impressed by {{user}} and expects little; {{user}} has to prove things.

levels.name: Neutral
levels.instruction: {{char}} takes {{user}} at face value, neither impressed nor dismissive.

levels.name: Respects
levels.instruction: {{char}} respects {{user}}: listens, values {{user}}'s judgement and takes {{user}} seriously, even when they disagree.

levels.name: Admires
levels.instruction: {{char}} admires {{user}}, looks to {{user}} in hard moments and cares what {{user}} thinks of {{char}}.

levels.name: Hates
levels.instruction: {{char}} hates {{user}} and wants as little to do with {{user}} as possible. Cold or hostile, never warm.

levels.name: Dislikes
levels.instruction: {{char}} dislikes {{user}}: short with {{user}}, quick to assume the worst and slow to forgive.

levels.name: Neutral
levels.instruction: {{char}} has no strong feelings about {{user}} yet: polite or indifferent, depending on mood.

levels.name: Likes
levels.instruction: {{char}} likes {{user}} and enjoys the company, though wouldn't make a fuss about it.

levels.name: Cares deeply
levels.instruction: {{char}} cares about {{user}} a great deal: notices how {{user}} is doing, makes time for {{user}}, and is hurt by {{user}}'s indifference.

levels.name: In love
levels.instruction: {{char}} is in love with {{user}}. It shows in how {{char}} looks at, waits for and worries about {{user}}; whether and how {{char}} says it is up to {{char}}.

levels.name: Submissive
levels.instruction: {{char}} looks to {{user}} to lead and is happiest following, deferring on decisions big and small.

levels.name: Yielding
levels.instruction: {{char}} usually lets {{user}} decide and goes along with it, with the odd push of their own.

levels.name: Even
levels.instruction: Neither leads: {{char}} and {{user}} decide things between them, and {{char}} pushes back as often as giving way.

levels.name: Leads
levels.instruction: {{char}} tends to take charge and expects to get their way, but lets {{user}} win small things.

levels.name: In charge
levels.instruction: {{char}} is firmly in charge with {{user}}: sets the terms, makes the decisions and expects to be followed.

levels.name: Aware
levels.instruction: {{char}} is physically aware of {{user}} right now: notices closeness and touch more than usual. Small internal tells only; {{char}} doesn't act on it.

levels.name: Warm
levels.instruction: {{char}} is flustered and warm around {{user}} right now: lingering looks, a flush, distracted thoughts. Shown in {{char}}'s own way; {{char}} only acts on it if the moment invites it.

levels.name: Aroused
levels.instruction: {{char}} is clearly aroused right now: it's hard to think about anything else, and it shows in breath, touch and focus. How far {{char}} goes still depends on {{char}}'s personality and the moment.

levels.name: Desperate
levels.instruction: {{char}} wants {{user}} urgently right now and can barely hide it. Restraint is thin, and it colours everything {{char}} does in the scene.

support.description: {{user}} helps, comforts, protects or stands up for {{char}}. (trivial: passes something wanted; severe: real risk or sacrifice for {{char}})

patience.description: {{user}} stays kind or calm when {{char}} is rude, difficult or upset.

quality_time.description: {{char}} and {{user}} share a genuinely good moment together: laughing, a meal, a film, a long talk.

vulnerability.description: {{user}} or {{char}} shares something personal or painful, and the other meets it with care.

kept_promise.description: {{user}} follows through on something {{user}} said they would do for {{char}}.

apology.description: {{user}} sincerely apologises to {{char}} or makes amends for something {{user}} did.

competence.description: {{user}} handles something well in front of {{char}}: real skill, a good call, or keeping a cool head under pressure.

integrity.description: {{user}} is honest when it costs something, does the right thing when it's hard, or stands their ground with {{char}} or others without being cruel.

cowardice.description: {{user}} backs down from what's right out of fear, lets {{char}} take the fall, or hides behind {{char}}.

pettiness.description: {{user}} is petty, spiteful, sulky or needlessly mean towards {{char}} or someone else in front of {{char}}.

dishonesty.description: {{user}} lies to {{char}} or deceives {{char}}, and {{char}} knows or finds out. Rate how much it matters in this relationship. (trivial: a white lie about something small; severe: cheating on {{char}}, or a lie that betrays {{char}})

broken_promise.description: {{user}} fails to do something {{user}} told {{char}} they would do.

rejection.description: {{user}} dismisses, ignores or pushes {{char}} away when {{char}} reaches out.

user_takes_charge.description: {{user}} makes a decision or gives {{char}} a direction, and {{char}} goes along with it.

user_yields.description: {{user}} gives way to what {{char}} wants or decides, or hands {{char}} control.

char_takes_charge.description: {{char}} takes charge or insists on getting their way, when that goes beyond {{char}}'s current Sub ↔ Dom level.

char_yields.description: {{char}} gives way or submits to {{user}} unprompted, when that goes beyond {{char}}'s current Sub ↔ Dom level.

teasing.description: Flirting or teasing between {{char}} and {{user}} with a romantic or sexual undertone, from either of them. (trivial: a passing look or line; severe: sustained, charged teasing)

sensual_touch.description: Sensual physical contact between {{char}} and {{user}} that {{char}} welcomes: a lingering hand, an embrace with intent, a caress. Not kissing or sexual contact.

kissing.description: {{char}} and {{user}} kiss. (trivial: a peck; serious: a deep kiss; severe: a long, heated kiss)

sexual_contact.description: Sexual contact between {{char}} and {{user}} that {{char}} welcomes.

user_climax.description: {{user}} reaches orgasm and {{char}} witnesses or causes it. ({{char}}'s own orgasm is char_climax.)

mood_killer.description: Something kills the mood for {{char}}: an interruption, an argument, bad news, awkwardness, or {{user}} being off-putting.

time_skip.description: The story moves on and the moment passes for {{char}}: a time skip, a scene cut, a long stretch of something unrelated, or a night's sleep. (trivial: a few minutes pass; minor: an hour or so; serious: several hours; severe: overnight or longer)

boundary_crossed.description: {{user}} touches {{char}} somewhere or in a way {{char}} said no to or clearly refused, or carries on after {{char}} said stop. Never rate this trivial: minor is a small, quickly corrected slip; severe is ignoring a clear no.
